Remark
[Choice of the finite approximation] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0238 \group Parametrix

For $N>n/2$ we seek \[ H_N(x,t;y,u)=E(x,t;y,u)\sum _{k=0}^N\phi _k(x,y)(t-u)^k \] on the injectivity neighborhood. The last term tends uniformly to zero as $t-u\to 0$ because $N>n/2$.
